analysis: Retrospective scoring of rejected full-harness candidate counts
primary_candidate_policy: Last proposed numerical count on every image, regardless of its error or Jev support. First attempt reported separately. No best-of-two selection.
metric: Mean over all six images of 100 * abs(prediction - mean(two human counts)) / mean(two human counts); lower is better.

summary.candidate_policy: Last proposed count before final rejection

interpretation: These are diagnostic candidate scores, not accepted full-harness output. Second attempts used feedback from Jev; this is not an independent run with Jev disabled. All six actual final outputs remain abstentions.
scope: Same six previously inspected BBBC001 images, one paired run. No inference or threshold changes.
